findings.text: an unmeasured clone report is stored as the empty list, so a run whose measurement could not be produced — a shadow, a run with no commit, an unreadable base or tip archive, or any exception out of clones.promotion_clone_matches — reads exactly like a run measured to copy nothing, while the comment at reckon/crew/promotion.py:5694-5695 still states that an unreadable revision leaves the key absent.

the manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite, so no reader can derive this run's added failures and its declared negative control has no readable comparison arm, which refuses its promotion until an arm is recorded or the control is waived; the only arm logs in the run directory are truncated mid-run, and the head one names 6d5c4655 rather than the promoted head 60b20938.

the fragment repeats the claim that an unreadable revision leaves the key absent, which the repair commit's reckon/ledger.py:1677 made false, so the evidence a later reader opens describes behaviour the code no longer has.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the three reconcile runs with their EXIT=0 results at the head revision and records no baseline_suite or after_suite, so the arm evidence is absent rather than recorded and the added-failure derivation reads unmeasured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the six declared write paths were read from the run prompt; the two commits change five of them and nothing else, reckon/clones.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_promotion_reports_clones.py and the fragment.

justifications.durability: tests/test_promotion_reports_clones.py:182-186 compares the reported line against an independently ast-parsed one and reddened under the run's own declared mutation, but no test separates an unmeasured report from a measured empty list.
justifications.evidence: the two tests the node names are recorded green at the head revision with EXIT=0, but the base and head arms the same done_when names are recorded nowhere and their only logs stop mid-run with no EXIT= line.
justifications.fit: the module keeps the census's own function names and cites docs/research/data/crew-pattern-review/code-depth/census.py in its docstring, and that file exists.

justifications.scope_discipline: every path in both commits is inside the declared write paths, and the repair commit changes only reckon/ledger.py:1673-1677.
